evidence: The films were deposited using a traveling wave-type thermal ALD reactor (Lucida-D100, NCD Technology, Korea) with the zero valence EBCHDRu as a precursor. The Ru precursor was vaporized in a bubbler at an elevated temperature of 100 oC and was carried into the process chamber with N2 gas flow rate of 100 standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM).
